stories.title: IndyCar races through Washington streets as Trump attends
new_facts: Kyle Kirkwood won the Freedom 250 Grand Prix in Washington, D.C.
Race framed as celebration of country's 250th anniversary; CEOs and lawmakers attending
Kirkwood's win was his second of the 2026 IndyCar season
Trump aide Natalie Harp attended and interacted with Eric Trump at the event
David Malukas and Sting Ray Robb involved in a Lap 36 crash
Twenty-five cars are competing in the race
Melania Trump's appearance was her second public appearance this week
Track is 1.7 miles long; Alex Palou started the race from pole position
Nolan Siegel, Marcus Ericsson, Mick Schumacher get six-place grid penalties for engine changes
stories.line: IndyCar is racing through downtown Washington DC today, with Trump appearing at the event.

stories.title: Trump escalates Canada tariffs as trade talks collapse
new_facts: Carney quoted saying 'we got attacked'; tariffs cited on items like hockey sticks and tongue depressors
Trump quoted saying "No more!!!" in reaction to Canada's tariff move
stories.line: Trump escalates tariffs against Canada after trade negotiations collapse, threatening economic damage to both countries.

stories.title: China delays moon mission to 2027 after launch setbacks
new_facts: New story: China postpones 2030 moon mission launch, citing unmet launch conditions, two weeks after a launch failure.
Names mission Chang'e-7, reveals new target launch date of 2027, cites 'absolute success' rationale.
Specifies Chang'e-7's goal: searching for water ice near the Moon's south pole; launch was days away.
stories.line: China postpones its Chang'e-7 moon mission to 2027, citing need to ensure mission success after recent launch setbacks.

new_facts: Humanoid robot set new 400m world record, beating human time by nearly five seconds
stories.line: Humanoid robots competed in track and field events at a Beijing games, setting records in sprinting.

stories.title: Newcastle and Liverpool honor Kevin Keegan after his death at 75
new_facts: Reveals match result: Liverpool salvage a draw via Szoboszlai's stoppage-time penalty; introduces new Liverpool manager Iraola.
Confirms exact scoreline 2-2 between Newcastle and Liverpool, with late Liverpool equaliser.
Introduces new Newcastle manager Matthias Jaissle and quotes a Keegan banner tribute at St James' Park.
New story: Newcastle and Liverpool jointly honoured late club legend Kevin Keegan before PL opener.
Reveals Keegan died aged 75; describes emotional tribute scenes at St James' Park.
Liverpool start 17-year-old Rio Ngumoha wide right after failing to sign Barcola or Minteh post-Salah.
stories.line: Newcastle and Liverpool players honored Kevin Keegan before their match after the former manager and player died at 75.
